lessons_used: Predictions tended to overestimate positive impact overall (especially in rounds 1, 2, and 5), but underestimated gains in winning tests during rounds 3, 4, and 6.
home wait_info changes can be helpful, backed by 2 winning tests in rounds 3 and 4.
sign_in hint changes can be helpful, backed by 2 winning tests in rounds 4 and 6, though 3 tests showed no clear effect (rounds 1, 2, and 5).
choose_path layout changes showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests (rounds 1 and 5).
home notification changes showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests (rounds 2 and 6).

Evidence remains thin for adoption redesign, finish new_flow, and finish new_screen because their tests disagree, as well as for choose_path copy, choose_path new_flow, finish copy, and sign_in reorder with only one test each.

candidates.title: Interactive Adoption Certificate Naming Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen with interactive pet naming input, custom badge options, and formal adoption seal confirmation.
candidates.why: Adoption stage experiences a high drop-off rate (33.8% drop, median 89s), so increasing emotional ownership before desktop generation will improve completion.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Give your new desktop companion a name to finalize adoption.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.replace.certificate[0]': a name_input cannot do the certificate job (use ['animation', 'badge', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Carousel During Render
candidates.change: Display an interactive tip carousel on the waiting screen showing keyboard shortcuts to hide, move, and summon the pet while rendering finishes.
candidates.why: Home wait time is high (median 201s) and 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or hide the pet post-onboarding.

waiting.hint: Pro tip: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime on your desktop to summon or hide your pet.

components.text: Learn Desktop Shortcuts while your pet renders

guard.reason: Valid enhancement adding helpful desktop shortcut hints to the waiting screen during pet rendering.

candidates.score_note: Proven home wait_info pattern; directly addresses 3 support emails on pet control confusion.

candidates.title: Desktop Quick Actions Overview Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated post-intro screen 'new_desktop_quick_actions' showing visual callouts for desktop tray icons, sound toggles, and pet interaction menus.
candidates.why: Users struggle post-onboarding with controlling, hiding, or talking to their pets (3 support emails) and overall onboarding completion is only 28.5%.

new_desktop_quick_actions.headline: Master Your Desktop Pet Controls
new_desktop_quick_actions.body: Right-click your pet on desktop to chat, feed, or minimize to system tray.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a new desktop quick actions screen following home_intro within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High effort new screen; finish new_screen changes historically performed poorly (-4.7% avg).

candidates.title: Account Persistence Safety Hint
candidates.change: Display a prominent reassurance hint on the sign-in screen clarifying that signing in preserves pet customization and prevents account resets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account persistence assurance essential during sign-in.

sign_in.hint: Signing in ensures your pet creation and customization are safely saved to your account forever.

guard.reason: Valid copy addition clarifying account persistence on the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Backed by 8 support emails and sign_in hints have a strong positive track record (+2.2% avg).

candidates.title: Photo Generation Quality Verification Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Insert a photo preview validation screen 'new_photo_quality_check' to ensure uploaded photos meet background removal and render requirements.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or weird visual results, causing frustration during the 1017s mean adoption phase.

new_photo_quality_check.headline: Photo Rendering Quality Check
new_photo_quality_check.body: We analyzed your upload. High lighting and clear outlines ensure perfect 3D pet generation.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a photo verification screen sub-flow inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop step, but adding sub-flows and redesigns in adoption step has negative historic returns.

candidates.title: Path Selector Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the choose_path screen with a stage layout, showing interactive companion choice cards and clear time expectations for preset vs custom paths.
candidates.why: Choose path has a mean time of 514s due to decision friction, and redesigning with stage layout provides immediate visual clarity.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Pet Creation Path
choose_path.body: Select Quick Adopt for instant desktop companion or Custom Studio for full photo crafting.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of choose_path that retains both adopting and making options.

candidates.score_note: High implementation cost with layout/redesign tests on choose_path showing no clear benefit.

candidates.title: Story Welcome Journey Time Expectations Copy
candidates.change: Update headline and body copy on the initial story screen to set clear time expectations for completing onboarding.
candidates.why: Users take long mean times across all onboarding steps (e.g. 514s choose_path, 567s sign_in), leading to drop-offs before completion.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Companion
story.body: In less than 3 minutes, your interactive virtual pet will live and play right on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Valid copy update on the story screen introducing the desktop companion.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy tweak; single prior choose_path copy test was positive (+3.9%).

candidates.title: Taskbar & Visibility Hint on Home Welcome
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint on home_intro screen telling users how to find the desktop app tray icon if the pet window closes.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted that the pet does not show on desktop or the app will not open after setup.

home_intro.hint: If your pet hides, click the Pet icon in your system tray (bottom right corner) to bring it back instantly!

guard.reason: Valid visibility hint added to the home_intro onboarding screen.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost hint addressing 3 support tickets regarding post-setup window visibility.

candidates.title: Live Rendering Estimated Time Progress Bar
candidates.change: Enable progress bar and time estimate display on the waiting screen while background assets compile.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s; previous lessons showed home wait_info changes are effective backed by wins in rounds 3 & 4.

waiting.headline: Crafting Your Desktop Companion
waiting.body: Setting up 3D desktop animations, interactive behaviors, and physics sound effects.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a progress bar and estimate during a real waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Proven wait_info pattern for high wait time bottleneck (201s median / 2336s mean).

candidates.title: Upload Guidance Hint for Custom Pet Creation
candidates.change: Add a clear upload guideline hint on the upload_photos screen explaining ideal lighting and framing for custom pets.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet creation failing or looking incorrect during adoption generation.

upload_photos.hint: For best results, upload well-lit photos facing forward with clear background contrast.

guard.reason: Valid guidance hint added to the photo upload screen.

candidates.score_note: Targets largest drop-off step (adoption, 33.8% loss) using low-friction hint guidance.

home wait_info changes can be helpful, backed by 3 winning tests (rounds 3, 4, and 7), though 2 tests showed no clear effect (rounds 1 and 5).
sign_in hint changes can be helpful, backed by 2 winning tests (rounds 4 and 6), though 4 tests showed no clear effect (rounds 1, 2, 5, and 7).
